title: Anatomy of a memory access, interactively
description: Interactive, animated diagrams of each level of the ET-SoC-1's memory system, from the part that serves an access down to the transistors that switch: the L1 data cache (latch RAM in the minion), the L2 in the shire cache, the L3 across the mesh, the scratchpad and the LPDDR4X DRAM, each access played step by step with the cycles and energy measured on three cards, every part badged as documented, generic or unknown, and the asks that would settle the unknowns.
